acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass visits refugee camps we don’t call refugee camps—right on our country’s doorstep.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Los Angeles Times reporter Molly O’Toole talks to U.S. asylum officers—the people who end up sending migrants back to Mexico. And they don’t feel good about it. Read Molly’s story.
acts.title: Goodbye, Stranger

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Reporter Emily Green happens to meet a man being sent back to Mexico who tells her he’s afraid of being kidnapped—and then, he gets kidnapped.
acts.title: Take the Long Way Home
